title: Wrap claim family values in opinions results table

comments.author: home
comments.text: Declared fix: the Claim family cell must wrap so every results-table column remains visible rather than forcing horizontal cropping.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Added reported issue: every claim-family heading and its source sentence need explicit whitespace/separation; e.g. ‘Anti-Jewish claims The Anti-Defamation League…’, not concatenated text.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implementation and verification: added a fixed-layout, full-width opinion-results table with a 40% wrapping claim-family column. Family labels and source text now render on separate block lines; score, range, and control comparison lines do too. Built the site, all 28 site tests passed, and a 390px browser check confirmed table scrollWidth equals clientWidth (359px), with no console errors.
